highlights.description: M1R17 | SunPayus - 4 AWP kills on the offensive (Part 1 - 2/4 frags)
M1R17 | SunPayus - 4 AWP kills on the offensive (Part 2 - 2/4 frags) - including REPLAY
M2R10 | HeavyGod - 1vs3 clutch (T - bomb planted after 1 clutch kill) - Part 1 - 1/3 frags
M2R10 | HeavyGod - 1vs3 clutch (T - bomb planted after 1 clutch kill) - Part 2 - 2/3 frags
M2R20 | Twistzz - 1vs2 clutch (T - post-plant situation) to keep FaZe in the running for Ancient
M3R1 | frozen - 4 Glock HS kills on the bombsite A offensive (REPLAY)
M3R14 | Neityu (CT) wins the 1vs2 time limited pre-plant situation with the help of the round timer in the final duel
M3R21 | HeavyGod (T) wins the 1vs2 post-plant situation with the help of the bomb timer after falling to the final CT to set G2 on match point
M3R23 | frozen - 4 kills (3 M4A1-S, USP-S HS) to turn an initial 2vs5 post-plant situation in favor of FaZe and keep them in the match
